note: Designed habitat preferences for the biome, not botanical claims. The body recipes are existing catalogue DNA. Add a tested adapter and space budget before admitting another builder. A family's `moisture` and `shade` are Astra's fitness terms; `lit` (0 shade-side .. 1 sun-side of the nearest trunk) and `near` ("water" in cells / "mineral" in metres, `near_weight` at distance 0, nothing at 3) are gen 13's optional terms. gen 13's builders take slots the object already owns: flower_preset the meadow cells _ecology() marks resident (a stride from the habitat seed), creature_dna every creature cell.
